def lora_parameter_count(d: int, k: int, r: int) -> tuple:
    """Trainable params for full fine-tuning vs a rank-r LoRA update of a (d, k) matrix."""
    full_params = d * k
    lora_params = r * (d + k)
    reduction_factor = round(full_params / lora_params, 2)
    return full_params, lora_params, reduction_factor

full_params, lora_params, reduction_factor = lora_parameter_count(4096, 4096, 8)
print(full_params)
print(lora_params)
print(reduction_factor)
